s01.text:
S01 Start window

What a window shows with no document: open a file, drop one, or pick a recent file (thumbnail, folder, last page).

States: recent files · first run (empty) · missing recent file (Remove) · drag-over overlay (doc).

Todos: D3a, D3b

s02.text:
S02 Tabs and session restore

Document tabs per window, tab overflow menu, and the notice after the last session is restored.

States: tabs + overflow menu open · restored tab whose file is missing (Locate…) · duplicate opens refocus a tab.

Todos: D4a

s03.text:
S03 Native menus

Menus generated from the command registry: macOS menu bar (File open, Open Recent) and the in-window menu bar on Windows/Linux (View open). Drawn schematically; the OS renders the real ones.

States: items disabled with no document · check items · submenus.

Todos: D4b

s04.text:
S04 File changed on disk

When another app changes the open file: reload, keep mine or compare (with unsaved changes); silent reload with a toast (reader); banner when the file was moved or deleted.

States: conflict banner (editor build, Editor top bar) · missing banner · reloaded toast and unreadable retry (doc). Desktop v0.1 has only reload, missing and retrying.

Todos: D3b; E1e (conflict)

s05.text:
S05 Print

Print hands off to the system dialog (drawn schematically) and lamina shows spooling progress with Cancel.

States: system dialog · spooling · cancelled · native path failed → compatibility (doc).

Todos: D4c

s06.text:
S06 Updates

A quiet status-bar item when an update is ready, with Restart to update; the Updates section of Settings shows channel, progress and Check now.

States: up to date · checking · downloading % · ready · error · managed by organisation · nightly · Stable not released yet (disabled). Reset anonymous ID lives here.

Todos: D5b

s07.text:
S07 Settings window

One window, sections in a side list; settings apply at once. General, Appearance, Updates (S06), Privacy (crash reports, usage counts), Shortcuts, Advanced (printing, Linux graphics), About.

States: managed policy · restart needed · crash-loop fallback notice.

Todos: D7b, D7a, U5c

s08.text:
S08 Crash recovered

Next launch after a crash: choose which tabs to reopen and, once, whether to send an anonymous report; preview shows the exact report.

States: dialog · report preview · engine restarted in place (doc).

Todos: D7a

s09.text:
S09 Download page (web)

The visitor’s OS first, every installer below with SHA-256, how to verify, system requirements and what the app sends.

States: Beta channel · Stable not released · unknown OS · fetch failed (doc).

Todos: D7b

s10.text:
S10 Windows frame

The reader with the Windows frame: caption buttons right, the native OS-drawn menu bar in the window (Alt shows access keys; not in the F6 cycle), Reader v0.1 top bar, Ctrl shortcuts. Linux: GTK menu bar, frame per desktop.

Todos: D4b
